title: The Flat CR Twistor Model $Q^{2,2}$ and Its Algebraic Sections
summary: We study the flat CR twistor model $Q^{2,2}\subset \mathbb{CP}^3$ by explicit projective methods. Using the anti-holomorphic involution $j$ associated with the twistor fibration, we classify the projective lines contained in $Q^{2,2}$ into twistor fibres and transverse lines, and relate the latter to round $2$-spheres in $S^3$ through an explicit incidence--tangency correspondence. We classify hyperplane sections under the twistor-compatible symmetry group $PSp(1,1)$ and describe the induced CR geometries on $S^3$.
